summary: Bound same-driver mailbox ownership contention before blocking-task submission

replay.detail: No source, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No persisted tables, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: Provider ownership checks, Store writer decisions and cross-process flock exclusion are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Mailbox ownership callbacks queue asynchronously per canonical driver lock path before blocking dispatch, without occupying shared writer admission while waiting for flock. Synchronous driver callers share a process-local descriptor; the on-disk lock protocol is unchanged. These callbacks no longer contribute to WriteWorkers admission queue metrics. Applies directly from all preceding binaries; no intermediate migration.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; no backfill or state rewrite.

manual.detail: No operator steps or pool-size changes required.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores prior callback scheduling without changing durable state.
